items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Dave Poikins; the interviewer states 'He'd blow his head off. He took lessons from Dave Poikins.' The interviewee does not confirm or deny this connection regarding himself.

ctx.x: Henry had an awful lot of stuff. I think Henry today playing trombone on the street, then, playing like he played then right today would be a sensation. Henry played. I was in Chicago just a couple years ago and I was with George Brunas' feelings every night, you know? And he's playing fine. He's playing real good. Oh, Henry, Henry was a good trombone. But you see, you're going to go into that same old argument again. He wasn't a school musician like Edwards was.
You understand? He wasn't what you call a real hot man. No, he had a lot of stuff. He had good execution and all, you know? And he'd blow his head off. He took lessons from Dave Poikins.
